name: Conditionings of Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Parents Are UOM Fibers
statement: After fixed coordinates are suppressed, every nonempty proper iterated conditioning of a connected conditioning-minimal non-ample class belongs to UOMFib.
proof: A connected conditioning-minimal non-ample class is the full tope set of a non-free simple uniform oriented matroid. Fixing one or more coordinates selects a nonempty topal fiber of that same uniform oriented matroid, which is precisely a UOMFib member.
